ai_extraction_decisions_value_check.name: ai_extraction_decisions_value_check
ai_extraction_decisions_value_check.value: ("ai_extraction_field_decisions"."decision" = 'rejected' and "ai_extraction_field_decisions"."accepted_value" is null) or ("ai_extraction_field_decisions"."decision" in ('accepted', 'corrected') and "ai_extraction_field_decisions"."accepted_value" is not null)

ai_extraction_spans_offset_check.name: ai_extraction_spans_offset_check
ai_extraction_spans_offset_check.value: num_nonnulls("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset", "ai_extraction_source_spans"."end_offset") in (0, 2) and ("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset" is null or ("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset" >= 0 and "ai_extraction_source_spans"."end_offset" > "ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset"))

buyer_provenance_correction_check.name: buyer_provenance_correction_check
buyer_provenance_correction_check.value: ("buyer_provenance_records"."source_type" = 'correction') = ("buyer_provenance_records"."correction_reason" is not null and "buyer_provenance_records"."supersedes_id" is not null)

document_external_shares_revocation_chec.name: document_external_shares_revocation_check
document_external_shares_revocation_chec.value: ("document_external_shares"."status" = 'revoked') = ("document_external_shares"."revoked_at" is not null and "document_external_shares"."revoked_by" is not null)

pilot_participations_active_owner_check.name: pilot_participations_active_owner_check
pilot_participations_active_owner_check.value: "pilot_participations"."status" not in ('active', 'paused', 'completed') or ("pilot_participations"."support_owner_actor_id" is not null and "pilot_participations"."started_at" is not null)

pilot_participations_end_check.name: pilot_participations_end_check
pilot_participations_end_check.value: "pilot_participations"."status" not in ('completed', 'withdrawn') or "pilot_participations"."ended_at" is not null

pilot_pass_grants_conversion_check.name: pilot_pass_grants_conversion_check
pilot_pass_grants_conversion_check.value: ("pilot_pass_grants"."status" = 'converted') = ("pilot_pass_grants"."converted_at" is not null and "pilot_pass_grants"."conversion_reference" is not null)

pilot_support_cases_resolution_check.name: pilot_support_cases_resolution_check
pilot_support_cases_resolution_check.value: "pilot_support_cases"."status" not in ('resolved', 'closed') or "pilot_support_cases"."resolved_at" is not null

quotation_versions_money_check.name: quotation_versions_money_check
quotation_versions_money_check.value: "quotation_versions"."freight_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."testing_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."finance_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."commission_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."fx_buffer_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "quotation_versions"."total_minor" = "quotation_versions"."subtotal_minor" + "quotation_versions"."freight_minor" + "quotation_versions"."testing_minor" + "quotation_versions"."finance_minor" + "quotation_versions"."commission_minor" + "quotation_versions"."fx_buffer_minor"

readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check.name: readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check
readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check.value:
("readiness_provider_referrals"."request_mode" = 'support_request' and "readiness_provider_referrals"."governance_evidence_reference" is null and "readiness_provider_referrals"."matched_provider_id" is null)
    or ("readiness_provider_referrals"."request_mode" = 'governed_referral' and "readiness_provider_referrals"."governance_evidence_reference" is not null)

realized_proceeds_money_check.name: realized_proceeds_money_check
realized_proceeds_money_check.value: char_length("realized_proceeds"."currency") = 3 and "realized_proceeds"."invoiced_minor" > 0 and "realized_proceeds"."received_minor" >= 0 and "realized_proceeds"."fees_minor" >= 0 and "realized_proceeds"."realized_minor" = "realized_proceeds"."received_minor" - "realized_proceeds"."fees_minor" and "realized_proceeds"."realized_minor" >= 0 and "realized_proceeds"."contribution_cost_minor" >= 0

regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check.name: regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check
regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check.value: ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."state" <> 'acknowledged') or ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."acknowledged_by" is not null and "regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."acknowledged_at" is not null)

regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check.name: regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check
regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check.value: ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."state" <> 'resolved') or ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."resolved_by" is not null and "regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."resolved_at" is not null)

shipment_exceptions_communication_check.name: shipment_exceptions_communication_check
shipment_exceptions_communication_check.value: not "shipment_exceptions"."buyer_communication_required" or "shipment_exceptions"."buyer_communication_audit_id" is not null or "shipment_exceptions"."status" not in ('resolved', 'closed')

staff_access_break_glass_check.name: staff_access_break_glass_check
staff_access_break_glass_check.value: not "staff_access_grants"."break_glass" or ("staff_access_grants"."second_approved_by" is not null and "staff_access_grants"."alerted_at" is not null)
